ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a piece of paper that was originally square, with the upper-right corner folded inward, and the outer contour after folding is an irregular pentagon. The upper-right corner is cut off by a diagonal line from the top side to the right side, and the triangular region formed by the fold appears darker gray in the figure, with its tip falling at the center position of the square. Reasoning: Let the side length of the square be s, set the upper-right corner as (s,s), and the center of the square as (s/2,s/2). The crease is the perpendicular bisector of the line segment between the original corner point and its image point, so the crease is the perpendicular bisector of the line segment from (s,s) to (s/2,s/2). The slope of this line segment is 1, so the slope of the crease is -1; its equation is x+y=3s/2. It intersects the top side y=s at (s/2,s), and intersects the right side x=s at (s,s/2). Therefore the two right-angle sides of the cut-off upper-right corner triangle are both s/2, and its area is (1/2)(s/2)(s/2)=s^2/8. The problem says that the area of the square is 1 greater than the area of the pentagon, and this difference is exactly the area of the cut-off triangle, so s^2/8=1, giving s^2=8. The area of the square is 8.

raw_record.question_text: One corner of a square is folded to its centre to form an irregular pentagon as shown in the diagram. The area of the square is 1 unit greater than the area of the pentagon. What is the area of the square?

method.method_draft: Model the displayed fold using coordinates. Read from the image that the folded corner is the upper-right corner, the outer pentagon is the original square with the upper-right triangular corner cut off by the diagonal crease, and the folded corner lands at the square centre. Let the square side be s and place the upper-right corner at (s,s), with the centre at (s/2,s/2). A fold crease is the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining a point to its image, so the crease is the perpendicular bisector of the segment from (s,s) to (s/2,s/2). This line is x+y=3s/2, meeting the top and right sides at (s/2,s) and (s,s/2). Therefore the removed corner triangle has legs s/2 and s/2, so its area is s^2/8. The text says the square area exceeds the pentagon area by 1, which is exactly the removed triangle area, so s^2/8=1 and the square area s^2=8.

图像描述：图中显示一个原本为正方形的纸片，右上角被折向内部，折后的外轮廓是一个不规则五边形。右上角被一条从上边到右边的斜线截去，折叠出的三角形区域在图中呈较深灰色，其尖点落在正方形的中心位置。

推理：设正方形边长为 s，把右上角设为 (s,s)，正方形中心为 (s/2,s/2)。折痕是原角点与其像点之间线段的垂直平分线，因此折痕是从 (s,s) 到 (s/2,s/2) 这条线段的垂直平分线。该线段斜率为 1，所以折痕斜率为 -1；其方程为 x+y=3s/2。它与上边 y=s 相交于 (s/2,s)，与右边 x=s 相交于 (s,s/2)。所以被截去的右上角三角形两条直角边都为 s/2，面积为 (1/2)(s/2)(s/2)=s^2/8。题目说正方形面积比五边形面积大 1，这个差正是被截去三角形的面积，因此 s^2/8=1，得 s^2=8。正方形面积为 8。
